maintenance_message: SariMe is temporarily unavailable while we deploy an important system update. All your store products, sales, and utang records are 100% safe on your phone.
maintenance_message_tl: Pansamantalang hindi magagamit ang SariMe habang naglalagay kami ng mahalagang update. Ligtas at buo ang lahat ng iyong paninda, benta, at listahan ng utang sa iyong telepono.

announcement.title: Welcome to SariMe v1.0.0!
announcement.message: Thank you for using SariMe! You can check for new APK updates anytime in Settings > Check for Updates.
announcement.message_tl: Salamat sa paggamit ng SariMe! Maaari kang mag-check ng bagong APK update anumang oras sa Settings > Check for Updates.
